seo.title: About | LUDA.AI
seo.description: A European team connecting legal understanding with practical technology.

title: Legal understanding, translated into useful technology.
intro: LUDA.AI is a European digital consultancy focused on the systems, information and tools behind modern legal work.

sections.title: Practical by design
sections.body: We favour clear, maintainable solutions over technology for its own sake. Every recommendation must support a real workflow and a responsible business outcome.

sections.title: Built in partnership
sections.body: We work closely with legal and operational teams, combining their domain knowledge with structured product and technology expertise.

sections.title: Responsible from the start
sections.body: Security, governance, adoption and long-term ownership are considered from the beginning, not added after delivery.
